description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for handling database operations related to NoteEntity objects within an Android application using Room persistence library. It includes query methods for observing, retrieving, inserting, updating, and deleting notes, as well as managing their synchronization state.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Room DAO interface for managing NoteEntity instances in the local database.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a reactive Flow stream of all non-deleted notes ordered by last update timestamp.

methods.name: observeSearch
methods.description: Returns a reactive Flow stream of notes matching a search query on title or content with wildcard escaping.

methods.name: observeById
methods.description: Returns a reactive Flow stream of a single note by its ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspending function to fetch a single note by ID, used for update semantics.

methods.name: getDirty
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve notes marked as 'dirty' for synchronization.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Saves or updates a single NoteEntity, replacing existing data on conflict.

methods.name: upsertAll
methods.description: Batch inserts or updates a list of NoteEntity objects.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted in the database, updating its timestamp and dirty flag.

methods.name: markClean
methods.description: Marks specified notes as clean (not dirty).

methods.name: purgeDeleted
methods.description: Removes all notes marked as deleted from the database.

methods.name: upsertInTransaction
methods.description: Performs batch upsert within a transaction to ensure atomicity.
